title: Paneer Butter Masala
description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich, creamy tomato and cashew gravy with warm spices.

steps.instruction: Boil 4 tomatoes, 1 onion, and 12 cashews in 2 cups of water for 10 minutes until soft.
Drain and blend the boiled mixture into a smooth paste. Set aside.
Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a pan over medium flame. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds and let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 2 cm ginger paste and 4 crushed garlic cloves. Saute for 2 minutes until fragrant.

Pour in the blended tomato-cashew paste. Stir in 1 teaspoon each of garam masala and red chili powder, half teaspoon turmeric, and 1 teaspoon salt. Simmer on low flame for 10 minutes until the oil separates.
Cut 250 grams of paneer into cubes and add to the gravy. Stir gently and cook for 5 minutes.
Add 3 tablespoons of fresh cream and mix well. Simmer for 2 more minutes.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot with naan or jeera rice.

title: Chicken Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced chicken, saffron, and mint, slow-cooked on dum.

steps.instruction: Wash 2 cups of basmati rice and soak in water for 30 minutes. Drain.
Marinate 500 grams of chicken with 0.5 cup curd, 1 teaspoon chili powder, 0.5 teaspoon turmeric, 1 teaspoon garam masala, and 1 teaspoon salt for at least 20 minutes.
Soak a pinch of saffron in 2 tablespoons of warm milk.
Boil 6 cups of water with 2 bay leaves, 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cardamom pods, 4 cloves, and 1 teaspoon salt. Add soaked rice and cook until 70 percent done, about 7 minutes.
Drain the rice and set aside.
In a heavy-bottomed pot, heat 2 tablespoons of ghee. Fry 3 sliced onions until golden brown, about 10 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste (3 cm ginger and 6 cloves garlic crushed) and saute for 2 minutes.
Add the marinated chicken and cook on high for 5 minutes, stirring well.
Add 2 chopped tomatoes, 2 sprigs curry leaves, and cook covered on medium for 15 minutes until chicken is cooked.
Layer the par-boiled rice over the chicken. Sprinkle saffron milk, fried mint, and coriander on top.
Seal the pot tightly and cook on the lowest flame for 15 minutes (dum cooking).
Mix gently before serving. Serve hot with raita.

title: Dal Tadka
description: Yellow lentils cooked soft and finished with a fragrant cumin and chili tempering.

steps.instruction: Wash 1 cup of toor dal thoroughly. Pressure cook with 3 cups of water, 0.5 teaspoon turmeric, and a pinch of salt for 4 whistles, about 12 minutes.
Whisk the cooked dal until smooth. Add 2 chopped tomatoes, 1 chopped onion, 4 crushed garlic cloves, 2 cm ginger, and 2 slit green chilies. Simmer on medium for 8 minutes.
In a small pan, heat 2 tablespoons of ghee. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds and let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 1 sprig curry leaves and 0.5 teaspoon red chili powder. Pour this tempering over the dal.
Add 1 teaspoon salt to taste, garnish with coriander leaves, and serve hot with rice or roti.

title: Chana Masala

title: Aloo Gobi
description: Potato and cauliflower dry curry with turmeric, cumin, and ginger.

steps.instruction: Cut 2 potatoes and 1 medium cauliflower into florets. Set aside.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds and let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 1 chopped onion and saute until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Add 2 cm grated ginger, 2 slit green chilies, and 1 chopped tomato. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add 1 teaspoon turmeric, 1 teaspoon coriander powder, 0.5 teaspoon chili powder, and 1 teaspoon salt. Mix well.
Add the potatoes and cauliflower. Toss to coat with spices. Cover and cook on low flame for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle 0.5 teaspoon garam masala and coriander leaves. Serve with roti.

title: Palak Paneer
description: Soft paneer in a silky spinach gravy with ginger, garlic, and cream.

steps.instruction: Blanch 4 cups of spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, then transfer to ice water. Drain and blend into a smooth paste.
Heat 2 tablespoons of butter. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds and let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 1 chopped onion and saute until golden, about 5 minutes. Add ginger-garlic paste and 2 slit green chilies. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add 2 chopped tomatoes, 0.5 teaspoon garam masala, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook until soft, about 6 minutes.
Cool and blend the onion-tomato mixture into a paste. Return to the pan.
Add the spinach paste and 0.5 cup water. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add 250 grams of paneer cubes and 3 tablespoons of cream. Simmer for 3 minutes and serve hot.

title: Masala Dosa
description: Crispy fermented rice and lentil crepe filled with spiced potato masala.

steps.instruction: Soak 1.5 cups rice, 0.5 cup urad dal, 0.25 cup chana dal, and 0.5 teaspoon fenugreek seeds separately for 6 hours.
Grind the urad dal to a fluffy batter, then grind the rice and dals to a smooth batter. Mix with 1 teaspoon salt and ferment overnight, about 8 hours.
Boil 4 potatoes until soft, peel, and mash roughly.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil. Add 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, 1 sprig curry leaves, and 2 slit green chilies. Let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 1 chopped onion and saute until soft, about 4 minutes. Add 0.5 teaspoon turmeric and 1 teaspoon salt.
Add the mashed potatoes and 0.5 cup water. Mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
Heat a flat tawa on high. Pour a ladle of batter and spread in a circular motion into a thin dosa. Drizzle 1 teaspoon oil around the edges.
When the dosa turns golden and crisp, place 2 tablespoons of potato masala on one side and fold. Serve with coconut chutney and sambar.

description: Crispy fermented rice and lentil crepe filled with spiced potato masala. Prepared here in the Punjabi style with regional spice adjustments.

steps.instruction: Punjabi style. Soak 1.5 cups rice, 0.5 cup urad dal, 0.25 cup chana dal, and 0.5 teaspoon fenugreek seeds separately for 6 hours.
Grind the urad dal to a fluffy batter, then grind the rice and dals to a smooth batter. Mix with 1 teaspoon salt and ferment overnight, about 8 hours.
Boil 4 potatoes until soft, peel, and mash roughly.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil. Add 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, 1 sprig curry leaves, and 2 slit green chilies. Let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 1 chopped onion and saute until soft, about 4 minutes. Add 0.5 teaspoon turmeric and 1 teaspoon salt.
Add the mashed potatoes and 0.5 cup water. Mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
Heat a flat tawa on high. Pour a ladle of batter and spread in a circular motion into a thin dosa. Drizzle 1 teaspoon oil around the edges.
When the dosa turns golden and crisp, place 2 tablespoons of potato masala on one side and fold. Serve with coconut chutney and sambar.

title: Samosa
description: Crispy fried pastry stuffed with spiced potato and pea filling.

steps.instruction: Mix 2 cups of wheat flour with 4 tablespoons of hot oil, 1 teaspoon salt, and enough water to form a stiff dough. Rest for 20 minutes.
Boil 3 potatoes, peel, and mash. Set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds and 1 sprig curry leaves. Let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 1 chopped onion, 2 cm grated ginger, and 2 slit green chilies. Saute for 4 minutes until onions are soft.
Add 0.5 cup peas, 1 teaspoon coriander powder, 0.5 teaspoon each of turmeric, chili powder, and garam masala, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook for 3 minutes.
Add the mashed potatoes and mix well. Cook for 2 minutes and let cool.
Divide the dough into 6 balls. Roll each into an oval, cut in half, and shape each half into a cone.
Fill each cone with 2 tablespoons of potato mixture. Seal the edges with water.
Heat oil for deep frying on medium flame. Fry samosas in batches for 5 minutes each until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with mint chutney.

title: Rajma
description: Red kidney beans simmered in a thick onion-tomato gravy with whole spices.

steps.instruction: Soak 1 cup of rajma overnight. Pressure cook with 4 cups of water and 0.5 teaspoon salt for 6-7 whistles, about 20 minutes, until soft.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil and 1 tablespoon of butter. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds and let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 2 chopped onions and saute until golden, about 6 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste (2 cm ginger, 4 cloves garlic) and 2 slit green chilies. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add 3 chopped tomatoes, 1 teaspoon coriander powder, 0.5 teaspoon each of turmeric, chili powder, and garam masala, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook until oil separates, about 8 minutes.
Add the boiled rajma with 1 cup of cooking water. Mash some beans to thicken the gravy. Simmer on low for 10 minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice.

description: Red kidney beans simmered in a thick onion-tomato gravy with whole spices. Prepared here in the Uttar Pradeshi style with regional spice adjustments.

steps.instruction: Uttar Pradeshi style. Soak 1 cup of rajma overnight. Pressure cook with 4 cups of water and 0.5 teaspoon salt for 6-7 whistles, about 20 minutes, until soft.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil and 1 tablespoon of butter. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds and let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 2 chopped onions and saute until golden, about 6 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste (2 cm ginger, 4 cloves garlic) and 2 slit green chilies. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add 3 chopped tomatoes, 1 teaspoon coriander powder, 0.5 teaspoon each of turmeric, chili powder, and garam masala, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook until oil separates, about 8 minutes.
Add the boiled rajma with 1 cup of cooking water. Mash some beans to thicken the gravy. Simmer on low for 10 minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Idli
description: Steamed fermented rice and lentil cakes, light and fluffy.

steps.instruction: Soak 2 cups of rice and 0.5 cup of urad dal with 0.25 teaspoon fenugreek seeds separately for 5 hours.
Grind the urad dal to a fluffy batter, then grind the rice to a smooth batter. Mix with 1 teaspoon salt and ferment overnight, about 8 hours.
Grease idli molds with oil. Pour a ladle of batter into each mold.
Steam in an idli cooker or steamer for 10 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Rest for 2 minutes, then unmold with a spoon. Serve hot with sambar and coconut chutney.

title: Poha
description: Flattened rice lightly tempered with mustard, curry leaves, and peanuts.

steps.instruction: Rinse 2 cups of poha in a colander under running water. Soak in 1 cup of water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil. Add 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, 1 sprig curry leaves, and 2 slit green chilies. Let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 3 tablespoons of peanuts and fry for 2 minutes until golden.
Add 1 chopped onion and 1 diced potato. Saute for 5 minutes until the potato is cooked.
Add 0.5 teaspoon turmeric and 1 teaspoon salt. Mix in the soaked poha. Toss gently for 2 minutes.
Squeeze half a lemon, garnish with coriander leaves, and serve hot.

title: Vada Pav
description: Spiced potato fritter in a soft bun with garlic and chili chutney.

steps.instruction: Boil 3 potatoes, peel, and mash. Set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil. Add 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, 1 sprig curry leaves, a pinch of asafoetida, and 3 slit green chilies. Let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 2 cm grated ginger and 4 crushed garlic cloves. Saute for 1 minute.
Add 0.5 teaspoon turmeric, 1 teaspoon salt, and the mashed potatoes. Mix well and cool.
Shape the potato mixture into 8 balls and flatten slightly.
Make a batter with 0.5 cup gram flour, 0.5 teaspoon salt, and water. Dip each vada in the batter.
Heat oil for deep frying. Fry vadas for 4 minutes each side until golden brown.
Slice 4 pav buns horizontally, place a vada inside with garlic chutney, and serve.

title: Butter Chicken
description: Tandoori chicken simmered in a velvety tomato, butter, and cream gravy.

steps.instruction: Marinate 500 grams of chicken in 0.5 cup curd, 1 teaspoon chili powder, 1 teaspoon garam masala, 1.5 teaspoon salt, and ginger-garlic paste (3 cm ginger, 6 cloves). Rest for 30 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan. Cook the marinated chicken on high for 8 minutes until lightly charred. Set aside.
In another pan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, 1 chopped onion, and saute until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add 6 chopped tomatoes, 1 teaspoon coriander powder, 1 teaspoon chili powder, and 1 teaspoon garam masala. Cook for 10 minutes until soft.
Cool and blend the mixture into a smooth puree. Strain back into the pan.
Add the cooked chicken and 0.5 cup water. Simmer on low for 8 minutes.
Stir in 4 tablespoons of cream, 2 more tablespoons of butter, and 1 tablespoon of crushed fenugreek leaves. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Serve hot with butter naan or jeera rice.

title: Matar Paneer
description: Paneer and peas in a spiced onion-tomato gravy.

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds and let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 2 chopped onions and saute until golden, about 5 minutes. Add ginger-garlic paste and 2 slit green chilies. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add 3 chopped tomatoes, 1 teaspoon coriander powder, 0.5 teaspoon each of turmeric, chili powder, and garam masala, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook for 8 minutes until oil separates.
Add 1 cup of peas and 0.5 cup water. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Add 250 grams of paneer cubes and 2 tablespoons of cream. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with roti or rice.

Add 1 cup of peas and 0.5 cup water. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Add 250 grams of paneer cubes and 2 tablespoons of cream. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with roti or rice.

title: Bhindi Masala
description: Stir-fried okra with onions, tomatoes, and warm spices.

steps.instruction: Wash 400 grams of bhindi (okra) and dry completely. Cut into 1-cm pieces.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds and let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 1 chopped onion and saute for 3 minutes. Add 2 cm grated ginger and 2 slit green chilies.

Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with roti.

title: Dhokla
description: Steamed fermented gram flour cake, spongy and tangy.

steps.instruction: Mix 1 cup gram flour, 0.25 cup curd, juice of half a lemon, 1 teaspoon sugar, 0.5 teaspoon salt, and 0.5 cup water. Whisk to a smooth batter. Rest for 15 minutes.
Add 0.5 teaspoon baking soda and 1 teaspoon oil. Mix gently. The batter will froth.
Pour into a greased 6-inch tray. Steam in a steamer for 15 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool slightly and cut into squares.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil. Add 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, 1 sprig curry leaves, and 2 slit green chilies. Let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Pour the tempering over the dhokla. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

title: Rava Idli
description: Quick steamed semolina cakes with curd, curry leaves, and cashews.

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil. Add 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, 1 sprig curry leaves, 2 slit green chilies, and 2 tablespoons of cashews. Fry for 1 minute.

title: Aloo Paratha
description: Whole wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced mashed potato.

steps.instruction: Mix 2 cups of wheat flour with 1 teaspoon oil, 0.5 teaspoon salt, and enough water to form a soft dough. Rest for 15 minutes.

Boil 3 potatoes, peel, and mash. Add 0.5 cup finely chopped onion, 2 chopped green chilies, 1 cm grated ginger, 0.5 teaspoon each of cumin, coriander, garam masala, chili powder, amchur, and 0.5 teaspoon salt. Mix well.
Divide the dough into 8 balls. Roll each into a 10-cm circle, place 2 tablespoons of filling in the center, gather the edges, and seal.
Dust with flour and roll gently into a 15-cm paratha.
Heat a tawa on medium. Cook each paratha for 2 minutes per side, drizzling 1 teaspoon of oil around the edges, until golden spots appear.
Brush with butter and serve hot with curd and pickle.

Boil 3 potatoes, peel, and mash. Add 0.5 cup finely chopped onion, 2 chopped green chilies, 1 cm grated ginger, 0.5 teaspoon each of cumin, coriander, garam masala, chili powder, amchur, and 0.5 teaspoon salt. Mix well.
Divide the dough into 8 balls. Roll each into a 10-cm circle, place 2 tablespoons of filling in the center, gather the edges, and seal.
Dust with flour and roll gently into a 15-cm paratha.
Heat a tawa on medium. Cook each paratha for 2 minutes per side, drizzling 1 teaspoon of oil around the edges, until golden spots appear.
Brush with butter and serve hot with curd and pickle.

title: Kheer
description: Rice pudding slow-cooked in milk with sugar, cardamom, and nuts.

steps.instruction: Wash 0.25 cup of rice and soak for 15 minutes. Drain.
Bring 4 cups of milk to a boil in a heavy-bottomed pan on medium heat, stirring frequently.
Add the drained rice. Cook on low for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is soft and the milk thickens.
Add 4 tablespoons of sugar, 4 crushed cardamom pods, 2 tablespoons of cashews, 2 tablespoons of raisins, and a pinch of saffron. Stir for 5 minutes.
Serve warm or chilled.

title: Gulab Jamun
description: Deep-fried milk-solid dumplings soaked in saffron-cardamom sugar syrup.

steps.instruction: Mix 1 cup milk powder, 0.25 cup wheat flour, and 0.25 cup milk to form a soft dough. Rest for 10 minutes.
Shape into 12 smooth balls without cracks.
In a separate pan, boil 1.5 cups of sugar with 1 cup water, 4 crushed cardamom pods, and a pinch of saffron for 8 minutes into a sticky syrup.
Heat oil on low. Fry the balls in batches for 5 minutes, stirring gently, until deep golden brown.
Drain and immediately soak in the warm sugar syrup. Rest for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Veg Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with mixed vegetables and whole spices.

steps.instruction: Wash and soak 1.5 cups of basmati rice for 30 minutes. Drain.
Boil 5 cups of water with 1 bay leaf, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 cardamom pods, 2 cloves, and 1 teaspoon salt. Add rice and par-boil for 7 minutes. Drain.
Heat 2 tablespoons of ghee. Fry 2 sliced onions until golden, about 6 minutes. Add ginger-garlic paste and saute for 2 minutes.
Add 1 diced potato, 1 diced carrot, 0.5 cup beans, 0.5 cup peas, 1 cup cauliflower florets. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add 2 chopped tomatoes, 0.25 cup curd, 1 teaspoon chili powder, 0.5 teaspoon turmeric, 1 teaspoon garam masala, and 1.5 teaspoon salt. Cook for 8 minutes.
Layer the par-boiled rice over the vegetables. Sprinkle mint and coriander on top.
Seal the pot and cook on the lowest flame for 15 minutes (dum).
Mix gently and serve hot with raita.

title: Jeera Rice
description: Basmati rice tempered with cumin seeds and whole spices.

steps.instruction: Wash 1 cup of basmati rice and soak for 15 minutes. Drain.
Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, 1 cinnamon stick, and 1 bay leaf. Let them sizzle for 30 seconds.
Add the drained rice and stir for 1 minute to coat with ghee.
Add 2 cups of water and 0.5 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and cook on low for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork, and serve.

title: Rasgulla
description: Spongy chenna (cottage cheese) balls soaked in light sugar syrup.

steps.instruction: Bring 1 liter of milk to a boil. Add 2 tablespoons of lemon juice diluted in 2 tablespoons of water, stirring gently until the milk curdles.
Strain through a muslin cloth. Rinse the chenna with cold water. Hang for 20 minutes to drain.
Knead the chenna for 8 minutes until smooth and soft. Shape into 12 small balls.
In a wide pan, dissolve 1 cup sugar in 4 cups of water with 2 crushed cardamom pods. Bring to a boil.
Add the chenna balls. Cover and cook on medium for 15 minutes until the balls double in size.
Cool completely before serving. Serve chilled.

title: Mishti Doi
description: Bengali sweet yogurt set with caramelized jaggery and milk.

steps.instruction: Boil 4 cups of milk on medium-high until it reduces to about 3 cups, stirring occasionally, about 15 minutes.
Cool the milk to lukewarm. Add 0.5 cup of melted jaggery and 2 tablespoons of curd as starter. Whisk well.
Pour into earthen pots. Cover and leave in a warm place for 8 hours to set.
Chill before serving.

title: Fish Curry
description: Fish simmered in a tangy tamarind and coconut gravy with curry leaves.

steps.instruction: Marinate 500 grams of fish pieces with 0.5 teaspoon turmeric, 0.5 teaspoon salt, and 1 tablespoon lemon juice for 15 minutes.
Grind 1 cup grated coconut with 1 tablespoon tamarind into a smooth paste. Set aside.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil. Add 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, 2 sprigs curry leaves, 3 slit green chilies, and let them splutter for 30 seconds.
Add 2 chopped onions and saute until golden, about 5 minutes. Add ginger-garlic paste (3 cm ginger, 6 cloves garlic) and saute for 2 minutes.
Add 2 chopped tomatoes, 1 teaspoon each of chili and coriander powder, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut paste and 1 cup water. Bring to a simmer.
Add the marinated fish. Cook on low for 10 minutes until the fish is cooked through.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with rice.
